page.title: Marbella Fishing & Sunset Combo Charter 2035 – Catch & Cruise

data.meta_description: Book a Marbella fishing sunset combo charter 2035 – catch & cruise from Puerto Banús. 4h fishing + 2h sunset, from €749. Includes skipper, drinks & snacks.
data.summary: Combine deep-sea fishing with a sunset cruise on this 6-hour Marbella charter. Depart Puerto Banús, fish the Mediterranean, then watch the sun dip behind La Concha with drinks and snacks included.

faq.q: What is the Marbella fishing sunset combo charter 2035?
faq.a: It’s a 6-hour experience combining 4 hours of deep-sea fishing with a 2-hour sunset cruise. You depart from Puerto Banús, fish the Mediterranean waters off Marbella, then cruise back as the sun sets over La Concha. All equipment, skipper, drinks and snacks are included.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the combo charter?
faq.a: The combo is available on our Tier A boats: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749 for 2h/4h. For larger groups, we offer the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4h minimum, including a free jet ski. Other yachts like the Ferretti 94 are available on request.

faq.q: What fish can I catch on this charter?
faq.a: Typical catches include sea bass, bream, mackerel, bonito, and sometimes amberjack or dentex, depending on season and water temperature. The Mediterranean off Marbella is productive year-round, with peak catches from May to October. Your skipper will guide you to the best spots.

faq.q: Do I need a fishing licence?
faq.a: No. All fishing equipment – rods, reels, bait, and tackle – is provided, and you don’t need a licence for recreational fishing on this charter. The skipper handles any regulations. Just bring sun protection, a hat, and a cooler if you want to take your catch home.

faq.q: What happens to the fish I catch?
faq.a: You can keep your catch (subject to size and species limits) or practice catch-and-release. The crew can clean and bag the fish for you to take back to your accommodation or a local restaurant that will cook it for you. Most Marbella restaurants are happy to prepare your fresh catch.

faq.q: What is included in the price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For the combo, fishing gear and bait are also included. No hidden extras – you just show up at Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What time does the sunset cruise part start?
faq.a: The 6-hour combo typically departs in the early afternoon (around 14:00) to fish during the best feeding hours, then transitions to the sunset cruise from about 18:00 to 20:00, depending on the season. Sunset times vary from 18:00 in winter to 21:30 in summer – we adjust departure accordingly.

faq.q: Can I book the combo on a larger yacht?
faq.a: Yes. While the standard combo is on Tier A boats, you can upgrade to the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4h minimum, which includes a free jet ski. For the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Contact us for group bookings.

data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a Mediterranean sunset on our Marbella fishing sunset combo charter 2035. This 6-hour experience from Puerto Banús gives you 4 hours of serious angling followed by a 2-hour sunset cruise past Marbella’s Golden Mile. From €749 on our Tier A boats, it’s one of the best-value days on the Costa del Sol. Browse all Marbella boat charters for more options.

How the combo works

Your day starts at Puerto Banús, where you meet your skipper. First, you head out to prime fishing grounds between Marbella and Cabopino. The skipper knows the local hotspots – reefs, drop-offs, and baitfish schools – and sets the lines. After 4 hours of fishing, you cruise back along the coast as the sun descends behind La Concha. Drinks and snacks flow throughout, and the skipper handles all navigation and safety.

Boats available for the combo charter

We offer the combo on several yachts from our fleet. The table below shows the standard options and upgrade choices.

Astondoa 4012.5m9€749 (2h/4h)Great for small groups
Azimut 3912.5m11€749 (2h/4h)More space, similar price
Mangusta 8024m12€4,719 (4h min)Includes free jet ski
Ferretti 9429m12On requestLuxury upgrade

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. For larger groups, contact us via WhatsApp for custom pricing on the Canados 86, K80, or Maiora 26m.

What you can catch off Marbella

The Mediterranean waters off Marbella hold a variety of species. Common catches include sea bass, gilthead bream, mackerel, bonito, and occasional amberjack or dentex. Best fishing runs from May to October when water temperatures peak, but you can catch year-round. The skipper provides all rods, reels, bait, and tackle – no licence needed. You can keep your catch or practice catch-and-release.

Sunset cruise route

After fishing, the skipper turns the bow toward Marbella Marina. The 2-hour sunset leg cruises past the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha mountain, the Marbella Club, and Puente Romano. You’ll pass Cabopino’s dunes and the Cala del Faro before returning to Puerto Banús as the sky turns orange and pink. It’s a perfect end to a day on the water.

What’s included in every charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full 6 hours
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, fruit)
  • Fishing rods, reels, bait, and tackle
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

You just bring sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, and a camera. If you plan to keep your catch, bring a cooler bag or ask the crew to prepare it for transport.

Why choose this combo over separate bookings

Booking a fishing trip and a sunset cruise separately would cost more and eat up two days. This combo gives you both in one seamless 6-hour trip from Puerto Banús, with the same skipper and crew throughout. You save time and money, and you get a more relaxed experience – no rushing between operators. Check our fleet overview for all available yachts.

How to book

Book directly through our website or via WhatsApp. For the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), the combo starts at €749. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, pricing is on request. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially from June to September when demand peaks. Cancellation policy: full refund if cancelled 72 hours before departure.
